evidence.rationale: GV-001's subject is an SDD-owned GENERATED VIEW, and no test run can discharge it — its discharge IS the durable artifact. FS.GG.SDD#865 is the open row for exactly that gap. A fabricated observedRun receipt would be the self-attestation FS.GG.SDD#350 closed, so this is recorded as an accepted deferral instead.
